semiconductor_relevance: High — General Bussan provides specialized equipment and systems for testing and measurement in the semiconductor industry.
summary: General Bussan specializes in manufacturing test sockets, temperature control systems, and plasma measurement equipment for semiconductor devices. Their products are utilized in various testing applications, including reliability and function testing for high-frequency ICs and automotive packages.
capabilities: Interposer sockets for millimeter-wave device testing
All-in-one temperature control systems for IC testing
Plasma spectrometers for emission and density monitoring
